subject: Intro: Redwood demo request — quick fit check
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@parceldrive.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Redwood demo request — quick fit check

Hi Alex,

Thanks for signing up with Redwood — I see ParcelDrive started a self-serve trial this morning and I wanted to do a quick fit check before locking a demo slot. I work on SDR outreach and will coordinate the demo and any CS follow-ups.

A few quick questions so we tailor the session:
- Primary use case you want to evaluate (e.g., in-app assistant, content generation, reranking)?
- Expected daily request volume for the first 90 days (rough ballpark is fine) and any predictable peak concurrency windows?
- Typical prompt size (tokens) or average input length (words)?
- Timeline: are you evaluating for a POC in the next 4–8 weeks, or later this quarter?
- Any security/compliance constraints (SSO via Okta, data residency, SOC2 requirements)?
- Would you like a sandbox with sample data for the demo, or a high-level walkthrough first?

If this looks good, pick one of these 30-min windows and I’ll send calendar invites: 
- Tue Apr 13, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Apr 14, 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu Apr 15, 09:00–09:30 PT

Or grab a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/priyom-30m

I’ve attached a short demo deck and a pre-demo checklist that helps us pre-seed a sandbox if you want one.

Thanks — look forward to hearing a bit about volume and timeline so we can make the session as useful as possible.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf, pre-demo-checklist.xlsx
From: Alex Chen <alex@parceldrive.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T12:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo request — quick fit check

On Tue, Apr 6, 2027 at 9:12 AM Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Alex,
> 
> Thanks for signing up with Redwood — I see ParcelDrive started a self-serve trial this morning and I wanted to do a quick fit check before locking a demo slot. ...

Hi Priyom — thanks for reaching out. Quick answers below so we can lock a slot: 
- Primary use case: in-app assistant for shipment tracking + returns assistance, with a light reranking step for suggested replies.
- Volume: planning a small pilot — expect ~100k requests/day once warm, with peak concurrency up to ~600 requests during batch windows.
- Prompt size: average user prompt ~350–500 tokens (long tracking context + short question).
- Timeline: pilot target in mid-June; demo this month would be great to accelerate procurement.
- Security: we use Okta SSO and require US-only data residency for this pilot; SOC2 compliance is a must.
- Sandbox: yes please — an ephemeral sandbox that can connect to sample tracking payloads would help (we can scrub real PII).

Any of your proposed slots work except Apr 15 morning. Can we aim for Wed Apr 14 at 14:00 PT? Also, is there a short usage matrix we can fill to speed things up?

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Head of Product, ParcelDrive
alex@parceldrive.com
+1 (617) 555-0987
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@parceldrive.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo request — quick fit check

Hi Alex — great, thanks for the detail and timeline. Wed Apr 14 at 14:00 PT works; I’ll tentatively hold that and send an invite once Monica confirms sandbox/SSO availability.

Monica — looping you in to confirm if we can provision an ephemeral sandbox that accepts sample tracking payloads and to confirm the Okta SAML flow. I’ve attached the pre-demo checklist that includes the quick usage matrix Alex mentioned — Alex, if you can fill the top section and send it back, that’ll speed setup.

Monica: are there any constraints on token limits or recommended model variants for ~500-token prompts at ~600 concurrent peaks? If you prefer, we can plan the demo with a Redwood engineer on to review throughput and quantization trade-offs.

Alex: I’ll send a calendar hold for Wed Apr 14 14:00–14:30 PT and include the Teams link.

Thanks both,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com

Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.xlsx
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@parceldrive.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood demo request — quick fit check

Thanks for the context, Alex — this is helpful. I can provision an ephemeral sandbox with sample tracking data and enable Okta SAML for the session. A couple of notes:
- For ~500-token prompts at peaks near 600 concurrency, we usually recommend a quantized model variant + batching; I’ll have an engineer available on the demo to cover throughput tuning.
- Please fill the top half of the attached pre-demo checklist (traffic slice, sample prompt, and an example payload) so we can seed the sandbox this week.

I’ve put the demo on the calendar for Wed Apr 14, 14:00–14:30 PT (Teams link included in the invite). If that changes, let me know and we’ll pivot.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

Attachments: sandbox-setup-steps.md, pre-demo-checklist.xlsx
